questions.q: How long is the sustained focus period in the Externally-set Assignment?
questions.why: The spec states a 10-hour period of sustained focus under exam conditions.

questions.q: When is the assignment released each year?
questions.why: Pearson releases it on 2 January each year.

questions.q: What must be submitted for Component 2?
options: Three A2 sheets of supporting studies and one A2 sheet of final outcome(s)
questions.why: Three sheets of supporting studies and one sheet of final outcome(s), max A2.

questions.q: Give two pieces of advice for using the 10 hours well.
questions.model: Have a clear design before starting and do the focal point first, then leave time at the end to review and finish.
points: prioritise focal point or leave review time
